item_short_desc: Rothco's Microlite Rain Jacket is a durable PVC coated nylon rain jacket that is 100% waterproof.
description: Rothco's Microlite Rain Jacket is a durable PVC coated nylon rain jacket that is 100% waterproof. The rain jacket features a front rustproof zipper with snap-up storm flap which provides added protection from the rain. In addition, the raincoat jacket features an attached adjustable spring-locked drawstring hood, hooks & loop wrist closures and riveted reinforced dual entry jacket pockets.
